title: 港灯与约定
approval_interpretation: Explicit adoption in user notes; original decision pending preserved unchanged.

prior_generation_request.prompt: Instrumental tender anime chamber duet about companionship and a promise to meet again at the harbor. Warm expressive middle-register piano presents a memorable affectionate four-bar melody; nylon-string guitar answers with a complete related phrase, like two close friends reassuring one another. The two voices take turns, then gently reunite on the same theme. Tender yearning resolves into trust, belonging and quiet happiness. Flowing lyrical phrasing, singing melody, warm major harmony with brief bittersweet suspended chords resolving naturally. Clear opening theme, short reflective bridge, emotionally warmer shared reprise, complete peaceful cadence. Sparse acoustic arrangement, delicate natural dynamics, clean intimate recording. No drums, busy ostinato, shrill high runs, vocals or sound effects.
